clearData.title: Clear my data
clearData.body: This removes everything this site has saved in your browser. It does not affect anything you have already sent us by email or WhatsApp, and it does not delete your enquiry.

a11y.mapTitle: Google Map showing the Urbane Ethos centre in Denai Alam, Shah Alam

map.notice: Shows our location on Google Maps. Loading it shares your device's IP address with Google — see our privacy notice.

media._note: Anchor JPGs hold real, consent-safe centre photos (no identifiable children, no personal data visible) plus on-brand illustrations for the home hero and the intro-video thumb. The earlier identifiable-children issue on yt-thumb-centre-tour.jpg is resolved — it now shows a child from behind on the sensory swing. PENDING before launch: set real data-yt-id on each <div class="yt-embed">. Keep the same filenames when swapping any image.
